verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is one community report of a manager building a backend with 'scheduled and webhook-initiated tasks' in n8n, which suggests time-based triggering exists. Nothing in the pack documents cron expressions or timezone settings. Missing for 10: first-party docs for a schedule/cron trigger node, cron-expression syntax support, timezone control (per-workflow or instance-level), hands-on corroboration of timezone-correct scheduling.
